answer: The vertex test I would run is Sworn game referee certification with games referees attestation: a certification referees renew after assessed matches, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a certification referees renew after assessed matches — so privacy survives, and the copper is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the river of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
